changes: Added pagination support across the Inventory tab, Sales product catalog, eLoad Queue (Pending & Recent), and Daily Logs tables with configurable page sizes (5, 10, 25, 50, 100).
Redesigned the application layout with a persistent modern left sidebar on desktop and streamlined top header bar.
Removed redundant user card and logout triggers from the sidebar to unify profile and session management in the header menu.
Optimized font and asset loading by reducing icon dependencies for faster render times.
Made the Version Notice modal body scrollable with constrained viewport sizing so long release notes never stretch the dialog card.
